title: AI Learning App
description: UI/UX overhaul and design system for an AI-powered learning platform at Carnegie Mellon.

caseStudy.blurb: A six-month redesign of Carnegie Mellon's AI-powered Search Ad Strategy Lab, rebuilt on a single design system so every module looks and behaves the same.
caseStudy.team: Client: Carnegie Mellon University, Tepper School of Business
objectives: Replace years of one-off styling with one documented token and component system.
Make all five student modules consistent, so the interface teaches the concept instead of competing with it.
Give engineering a system to build from, not a stack of screens.
caseStudy.contribution: As sole designer, I audited the existing interface, then built the foundation first: semantic color, one type family, and components specified across every state, with CMU's carmine reserved for brand and never for errors. I rebuilt all five module flows on top of that system.
results: A Figma design system: tokens, a fully specified component library, and page-level patterns.
All five modules redesigned on one consistent system.
Developer-ready handoff for a TypeScript/React frontend.
